artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p>5$ be a prime. Let $H_n=\sum_{k=1}^n 1/k$ denote the $n$-th harmonic number, let $B_n$ denote the $n$-th Bernoulli number, let $\left(\frac{\cdot}{p}\right)$ be the Legendre symbol, and define
$$\bar H^{(2)}_k := \sum_{0<j\le k}\frac{1}{(2j-1)^2}.$$
All congruences below are to be interpreted in $\mathbb{Z}_{(p)}$ (i.e., among rational numbers whose denominators are coprime to $p$).

Prove or disprove the following five congruences:

(i) $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{(p-3)/2}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}}{(2k+1)\,16^k}\;\equiv\;(-1)^{(p-1)/2}\!\left(\frac{H_{p-1}}{12}+\frac{3p^4}{160}B_{p-5}\right)\pmod{p^5},$

(ii) $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{(p-3)/2}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}}{(2k+1)^3\,16^k}\;\equiv\;(-1)^{(p-1)/2}\!\left(\frac{H_{p-1}}{4p^2}+\frac{p^2}{36}B_{p-5}\right)\pmod{p^3},$

(iii) $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{(p-3)/2}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}}{(2k+1)^2\,(-16)^k}\;\equiv\;\frac{H_{p-1}}{5p}\pmod{p^3},$

(iv) $\displaystyle\sum_{p/2<k<p}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}}{(2k+1)^2\,(-16)^k}\;\equiv\;-\frac{p}{4}B_{p-3}\pmod{p^2},$

(v) $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{(p-3)/2}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}\,\bar H^{(2)}_k}{(2k+1)\,16^k}\;\equiv\;\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)\frac{H_{p-1}}{12\,p^2}\pmod{p^2}.$
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture appears in Z.-W. Sun's compilations of open congruence conjectures (notably the running list "Open Conjectures on Congruences" and "Conjectures and Results on x^2 mod p^2..."). A targeted web search did not surface a published proof of this particular package of five congruences (Conjecture A32). Related conjectures of Sun on sums $\sum \binom{2k}{k}/((2k+1)m^k)$ have been proved in subsequent work, but no specific resolution of these five congruences modulo high prime powers was located, so the status is treated as unknown / likely still open.
